[Water][Colorless][Colorless] Crushing Wave — Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. After doing damage, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent discards an Energy card, if any, attached to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
